sentences.en: He had complete mastery over the necessary mathematics formula.
sentences.zh: 他完全掌握了必要的数学公式。

sentences.en: She has a great mastery of the Italian language.
Drawing on my fine mastery of the English language, I said nothing.
sentences.zh: 凭借我出色的英语能力，我没有说什么。

senses.zh: 掌握；精通；优势；征服；统治权

mnemonic: 词根记忆：master（掌握）+y→精通，熟练
